references.title: Google Street View, Hämeentie office front opposite number 42, May 2022, heading 75 degrees

observations: Long red-brown brick office wing with seven rows of small plain rectangular windows, pale sills and a flat gray roof edge.
The adjacent broad glazing ribbons and rounded corner have different architectural treatments; they are not assigned this small-window chart.
Street hedge and tree occlusion are scenery, not wall features; the original drawing omits their silhouettes.
limitations: Only the large exact northwest-facing brick plane is repainted. Source-selected triangles are coplanar parts of the same VTJ building.
Some window axes are obscured by trees in the reference. Regular spacing is an original approximation at 1.8 metre modules; no surveyed column count is claimed.
Unobserved courtyard, party walls, adjacent ribbon-glazed planes and curved corners are excluded from this chart.
